column1: # 121-signature-examples.tsv: the table every reader of a message's signature is graded by (issue 214).
# One example a line: text, body, signature, how (line, last-word or none), a note; separated by tabs.
# In the first three fields \\ \t \n \r are a backslash, tab, line feed and carriage return (the log's
# escapes), and \xHH is the byte with that hex value.  Lines starting with # are comments.
